name: Alea Quantum Technologies
description: Alea Quantum Technologies is a DTU spinout that builds high-performing optical quantum random number generator (QRNG) chips for cybersecurity, encryption, and quantum key distribution systems. The company commercializes 20+ years of quantum communication research at the Technical University of Denmark, packaging QRNG generation into chip-scale modules suitable for telecoms and mobile devices. Founded in March 2022 in Lyngby, Alea is backed by the Novo Nordisk Foundation, EU grants, and Innovation Fund Denmark.

news.title: Quantum technology for mobile phone encryption is coming
news.excerpt: DTU spin-out company Alea Quantum Technologies has developed a quantum mechanical random number generator that is so simple that it can be produced at a low price and support encryption of 4 gigabytes per second. The EU has granted DKK 7 million for further development under the Digital Europe programme.

news.title: QRNG chips for mobile – Danish tech start-up adds to ecosystem
news.excerpt: QRNG chips for mobile devices promise an upgrade in keeping smartphone communications safe. The technology enables quantum random number generators as a compact source of entropy for mobile handsets and IoT devices.
